title: Eleanor Roosevelt College General Education
source_note: ERC 学院官网 GE 页 + UCSD catalog（2026-10-28 核对）；PHYS 5/7/9/13 已停开（2024 春最后开课），不列入。

sections.title: Making of the Modern World

requirements.name: Making of the Modern World
requirements.note: MMW 11-15, letter grade, at UCSD only. AP/IB/transfer coursework exempts no quarter. ELWR is a prerequisite for MMW 12/13 (it does not waive MMW 11). R versions also count.
requirements.note_zh: MMW 11–15，须 letter grade、只在 UCSD 修；AP/IB/转学分不免任何一季；修 MMW 12/13 前须满足 UC 入学写作要求（该要求不免 MMW 11）；R 远程版亦可。

sections.note: MMW 11-15, letter grade, at UCSD only.
sections.note_zh: MMW 11–15，须 letter grade、只在 UCSD 修。

requirements.name: Quantitative and Formal Skills
requirements.note: 2 courses from Mathematics, Computer Programming, Formal Logic, Statistics, or Other approved lists. Letter or P/NP (check major overlap rules).
requirements.note_zh: 定量与形式技能 2 门（数学/编程/形式逻辑/统计/其他批准清单）；letter 或 P/NP 均可（与专业重叠时按专业规定）。

sections.title: Natural Science

requirements.name: Natural Science
requirements.note: 2 courses from Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Astronomy, Oceanography, or Physical Geology approved lists. Lab courses alone do not fulfill the requirement. Letter or P/NP (check major overlap rules). PHYS 5/7/9/13 (last offered Spring 2024) are excluded.
requirements.note_zh: 自然科学 2 门（生物/化学/物理/天文/海洋/地质批准清单）；单实验课不算；letter 或 P/NP 均可（与专业重叠时按专业规定）。PHYS 5/7/9/13 已停开，不列入。

sections.note: 2 courses from approved lists; lab alone does not count.
sections.note_zh: 2 门（批准清单）；单实验课不算。

sections.title: Foreign Language

requirements.name: Foreign Language proficiency
requirements.note: Proficiency: completion of a fourth-quarter (or third-semester) college language course, placement into fifth-quarter level, or a UCSD proficiency exam; AP/IB scores may exempt part or all. 0-4 courses depending on placement. Fourth-quarter courses listed here (LISL/LIAB/LIFR/LIGM/LIIT/LIPO/LISP 1D/DX; LTFR/LTGM/LTIT 2A; LTSP 2A/2F; LTGK 101; LTLA 100; LTKO 2A; LTRU 2A; CHIN 20A; JAPN 20A; JWSP 104; upper-division LIHL heritage courses). Language courses may NOT overlap Regional Specialization (including prerequisites to the fourth-quarter course).
requirements.note_zh: 外语达标：修到第四学期（或第三学季）水平、考入第五学期水平、或通过 UCSD 达标考试；AP/IB 可免部分或全部，按 placement 从 0 到 4 门。下表为第四学期水平课程（另有高年级 LIHL 传承语言课）。外语课（含修到第四学期水平的前置课）不得与区域专攻重叠。

sections.note: Proficiency: fourth-quarter level or exam, 0-4 courses.
sections.note_zh: 达标制：第四学期水平或考试，0–4 门不等。

requirements.name: Fine Arts
requirements.note: 1 course (at least 4 units). Any 4-unit course in Music, Theatre & Dance, or Visual Arts qualifies (1-3 unit courses do not); plus FILM 71/72/73, LTEA 120A/120B/120C/138, COMM 50/80. Letter or P/NP. May NOT overlap Regional Specialization.
requirements.note_zh: 美术 1 门（至少 4 学分）：音乐/戏剧舞蹈/视觉艺术任一 4 学分课均可（1–3 学分课不算），另加 FILM 71/72/73、LTEA 120A/120B/120C/138、COMM 50/80；letter 或 P/NP 均可；不得与区域专攻重叠。

sections.title: Regional Specialization

requirements.name: Regional Specialization
requirements.note: 3 courses from the same designated region (FA21 and after: Africa; Multiculturalism in North America; Latin America; Asia/Pacific; Europe; Middle East). At least two must be upper division; one may be P/NP, the other two letter grade. Regional course lists are published per region by the college (see source link). May overlap the Upper-Division Writing requirement; may NOT overlap Fine Arts or Language.
requirements.note_zh: 区域专攻 3 门（同一指定区域；2021 秋及以后入学的区域：非洲、北美多元文化、拉丁美洲、亚太、欧洲、中东）。至少 2 门高年级；1 门可 P/NP、其余须 letter grade。各区域课单由学院分区域公布（见来源链接）。可与高年级写作重叠；不得与美术或外语重叠。

sections.note: 3 courses in one region, at least 2 upper division.
sections.note_zh: 同一区域 3 门，至少 2 门高年级。

requirements.name: Upper-Division Writing (paper requirement)
requirements.note: Not a course: at least one upper-division course in the program must include a significant writing component (4500-5000 words, or an 18-20 page paper), from the college Approved Upper-Division Writing list, or by petition with syllabus + graded paper(s) (Option A: one 2500+ word paper; Option B: portfolio totaling 3000+ words with one 1500+ word paper). Papers must be in English, graded C- or better. Poetry, short stories, in-class exams, group projects, lab reports do not count.
requirements.note_zh: 非课程要求：至少一门高年级课须含 significant writing（4500–5000 词或 18–20 页论文），选学院批准清单内的课，或凭大纲 + 成绩论文 petition（A：单篇 2500+ 词；B：作品集共 3000+ 词、其中一篇 1500+ 词）。论文须英文、C- 及以上；诗歌、短篇、在堂考试、小组项目、实验报告不算。

sections.title: Transfer Students

requirements.name: MMW for transfers
requirements.note: IGETC/Cal-GETC/UC Reciprocity transfers: MMW 122 (letter grade, D or better). Partial IGETC: MMW 122 if IGETC Areas 1A and 1B are done, else MMW 12 (6 units); plus the 1-2 missing IGETC requirements. CalGETC without LOTE certification: MMW 122 plus one college-level LOTE course or LOTE proficiency. Transfers: 2 regional courses from the same region, both upper division (instead of 3).
requirements.note_zh: IGETC/Cal-GETC/UC Reciprocity 转学生：MMW 122（letter grade、D 及以上）。部分 IGETC：1A 与 1B 均完成者修 MMW 122，否则修 MMW 12（6 学分），另补 1–2 门缺失 IGETC 要求；CalGETC 缺 LOTE 认证者另补 1 门大学 LOTE 课或证明 LOTE 达标。转学生区域专攻为同一区域 2 门、均为高年级（非 3 门）。

sections.note_zh: 转学生：MMW 122（或 MMW 12）+ 区域 2 门。
